_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: E[Y(a, M(a*))] integrated over the covariate by fixture.truth() and checked with scipy quad

agreement.claim: both engines report the same natural direct, indirect and total effects and their standard errors
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/instrument_examples.test.py rebuilds the sandwich with numerical derivatives (1e-7) and, over 100 seeds, shows the counterfactual NIE on the log-odds scale is unbiased (mean 0.324 against 0.323) while the difference method averages 0.257.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Both tolerances separate the effect from zero (NDE 0.102, NIE 0.079). Measured by harness/instrument_examples.test.py, running python.py on seeds 0 to 99.
